title: Error messages with inserts
description:
Turn error codes into messages, filling `%1` style inserts the way `FormatMessage` does.

```
2   -> The system cannot find the file specified.
5   -> Access is denied.
32  -> The process cannot access the file because it is being used by another process.
format("Cannot open %1: %2", {"save.dat", "Access is denied."})
    -> Cannot open save.dat: Access is denied.
```
hints: Walk the text; at a `%` followed by a digit, append `inserts[digit - 1]` if it exists (lesson 1.01).
On Windows, `FormatMessageW(FORMAT_MESSAGE_FROM_SYSTEM | ...)` gives the real text for any code.
requirements: A small table of common error codes and their texts.
`format(text, inserts)` replaces `%1` to `%9` and leaves `%%` as `%`.
stretch: Remove the trailing new line that `FormatMessage` adds to system messages.
